result.title: BFHD: Bidirectional Feature Harmonization Decomposition for Heterogeneous Clinical Assessments
result.comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables. Extended version of the paper published in IJCAI-ECAI 2026, including additional supplementary material in the appendices
result.summary: Clinical assessments are often collected using heterogeneous assessment systems across centers and time, leading to records that mix different but related sets of measurements. This motivates harmonization beyond total-score linking. We formulate clinical harmonization at the measurement level as a bidirectional recoverability problem: given paired observations from two assessment systems, the goal is to identify which measurements can be reliably translated in both directions within an application-defined tolerance, while separating non-translatable components. We propose Bidirectional Feature Harmonization Decomposition (BFHD), a feasibility-driven framework that enforces bidirectionally coupled translation and uses feature-wise output gating to produce an explicit decomposition in the original measurement space. Experiments on synthetic data and real clinical assessment pairs show that BFHD achieves broader feasible harmonization coverage and improved subset stability compared to baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把跨量表临床评估的协调问题重构为测量级的双向可恢复性问题，提出 BFHD 框架：通过双向耦合的翻译与特征级输出门控，在原测量空间显式分离可可靠互译与不可互译的成分，并在合成数据和真实评估对上比较覆盖度与子集稳定性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「双向可恢复性 + 容差内判定 + 特征级门控分解」的评估视角，可能可供核查地迁移为判断 LVR 内部状态中哪些视觉细节维度能被双向重建、哪些属于不可迁移成分。
